question: Can I affect an opponent's production or resources?
expected: Yes, but only when the resource or production symbol on the card has a red border; then you may reduce any player’s.

"A card that removes red-borded resources, may remove those resources from any one player (this effect may also be performed partly, or not at all)." [Terraforming Mars p.15]

"When removing production from an opponent, you must choose 1 opponent to remove the production from. You cannot remove production from multiple opponents using one card." [Terraforming Mars p.17]

Answer: Yes, but only through cards or effects with a red border around the resource or production symbol. Those can target any one player, including an opponent, and you can only pick one opponent per card. Resources or production without a red border always affect only yourself. Removing red-bordered production is mandatory if possible, and if no opponent has that production you must reduce your own or not play the card. Removing red-bordered resources is optional and can be done partly or not at all.
